input.overview: Seven Up has two separate Special ladders. Spot all six numbered switches to score 300 and raise the No. 7 target; hitting the raised 7 scores 500 and advances its ladder. Separately, A-B-C-D-E advances the backglass skier until the right-side Special rollover lights.
input.simpleOverview: Spot numbers 1 through 6 with the upper targets, side targets, and rollovers. Completing the set scores 300 and raises the No. 7 target; hit the raised 7 for 500 and one Advance step. Repeat that controlled cycle toward Special. Treat A-B-C-D-E and the skier as a second route, and finish it only when a missing letter or the lit right-side Special is safely available.
input.summary: Build the numbered set, collect the raised 7, and repeat while the center return stays controllable. Switch to the A-B-C-D-E skier route only when it is close to completion or its Special is already lit.

quickInfo.name: Numbers 1–6
quickInfo.summary: Completing all six scores 300 and raises the center No. 7 target.

quickInfo.name: Raised No. 7
quickInfo.summary: Scores 500 and advances the No. 7 Special ladder when hit.

quickInfo.name: No. 7 Special
quickInfo.summary: Lights after three Advance steps on liberal setup or four on conservative setup.

quickInfo.name: Skier route
quickInfo.summary: A-B-C-D-E advances the backglass skier; reaching the bottom lights the right-side Special rollover.

steps.text: Read the numbered lamps and spot the missing 1–6 switches without forcing a dangerous rebound.
After all six are spotted, shoot the raised No. 7 target for 500 and one Advance step.
Repeat the numbered-set-to-7 cycle only while the center feed and post setting remain controllable.
Use A-B-C-D-E as the secondary route when the skier is already near the bottom.
When the skier reaches the bottom, collect the lit right-side Special only on a safe feed.
Spot the remaining numbers from 1 through 6.
Hit the raised No. 7 target for 500 and an Advance step.
Repeat until the No. 7 Special lamp is on, then collect it without forcing the center shot.

cautions.issue: The No. 7 Special needs three Advance steps on liberal setup and four on conservative setup, and the post positions change the return risk.
cautions.response: Read the installed setup before committing to repeated center cycles, and abandon the ladder when the return is not controllable.

machineSetup: Confirm this is replay-model Seven Up, Williams model 372. Do not transfer its replay awards to add-a-ball Set Up, model 373.
Check three- or five-ball play, liberal or conservative post positions, the three- or four-step No. 7 threshold, and whether Special awards a replay, points, or nothing.

Test every 1–6 switch and lamp, the 300-point completion relay, the raising No. 7 target and Advance unit, A-B-C-D-E, the skier unit, the right-side Special rollover, flippers, posts, and tilt response.
